raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## What
This PR focuses on two issues:
1) Enable/ensure Megatron (and Megatron-Bridge) patches are active in the posttrain flow.
2) Fix intermittent failures where posttrain framework detection is corrupted by noisy stdout.

## Why
- Patches are required to keep behavior consistent across environments and apply known fixes automatically.
- Framework parsing could intermittently fail when unrelated stdout (e.g. "Created path: ...") polluted the captured output, leading to a wrong hook directory path.

## Key Changes
- `runner/helpers/hooks/train/posttrain/dispatch_framework.sh`
  - Make `FRAMEWORK` extraction robust by taking **only the last stdout line**.
  - Keep debug logs on stderr.
- (Other commits in this branch) Megatron-Bridge posttrain flow updates and examples/presets that help validate the patch+dispatch behavior.

## Pull request overview

This PR improves framework detection in the posttrain hooks by parsing the framework value from the last line of stdout, making the extraction more robust against debug output. It also adds several new configuration files for training different model variants and renames one existing configuration.

**Changes:**
- Enhanced framework extraction logic to use `tail -n 1` to capture only the last stdout line
- Added new configuration files for qwen3_32b and llama31_70b models with both SFT and LoRA variants
- Renamed qwen3_8b_sft_posttrain to qwen3_8b_lora_posttrain and removed duplicate qwen3_32B_lora_posttrain file

Copilot reviewed 7 out of 7 changed files in this pull request and generated 2 comments.

| examples/megatron_bridge/configs/MI355X/qwen3_8b_sft_posttrain.yaml | Updated experiment name from qwen3_8b_sft_posttrain to qwen3_8b_lora_posttrain |
| examples/megatron_bridge/configs/MI355X/qwen3_32b_sft_posttrain.yaml | Added new configuration for qwen3_32b SFT training |

| examples/megatron_bridge/configs/MI355X/qwen3_32B_lora_posttrain.yaml | Removed duplicate configuration file (case variation) |
| examples/megatron_bridge/configs/MI355X/llama31_70b_sft_posttrain.yaml | Added new configuration for llama31_70b SFT training |
| examples/megatron_bridge/configs/MI355X/llama31_70b_lora_posttrain.yaml | Added new configuration for llama31_70b LoRA training |
</details>

The stderr redirection `2> >(tee /dev/stderr >&2)` is redundant since it duplicates stderr to itself. This construction doesn't add value and makes the command harder to understand. Consider simplifying to just `2>&1 >&2` if you need stderr visibility, or remove it entirely if the debug output to stderr is already sufficient.

